notes.title: Early Access launches in October 2025!
notes.content:
[h2]Big announcement! My Card Is Better Than Your Card! is coming to Steam Early Access in 

October 2025![/h2][p]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45598452/f4d5d84e1a31b193c91e5bf0b4450ec2646b5c3a.png"][/img][/p][h2]Why Early Access? [/h2][p]Originally, we planned to launch the game as full release by October with a more limited set of features. But, thanks to the support our game has received, we realized that it would now be possible for us to aim for a more feature-rich full release version of our game than we had previously thought. Instead of delaying the release, we feel Early Access is the better option. 

The support and love we’ve received for this game has been amazing, and words aren’t enough to express how blown away and grateful we are for that! Through your feedback we’ve heard lots of great wishes and suggestions that we agree with and want to see in the full version of the game. We want to be able to make more of those ideas come true. Going into Early Access will help us make the game better with you, our community.  

The game will be fully playable at Early Access launch with a bunch of new content! 

[/p][h2]Features at Early Access launch include: [/h2][list][*][p]Over 200 adorable and cool stickers to discover! (Over three times more than in the demo!)  [/p][/*][*][p]Over 40 toys to play with! (And now you can get more during your runs!) [/p][/*][*][p]Ten unique opponents to play against – 5 new friends since the demo! And you could even run into different versions of them, with different decks and playstyles [/p][/*][*][p]3 challenging bosses to truly test your deckbuilding skills at the end of each week [/p][/*][*][p]10 starter decks with their own themes and playstyles to unlock and choose from for each run [/p][/*][*][p]Super special Story Events to spend time with your friends from the neighborhood! Challenge them to water fights or go on an adventure in the forest! Who knows what’ll happen! [/p][/*][*][p]15 different types of themed Booster Packs to open [/p][/*][*][p]Our very own original soundtrack [/p][/*][*][p]Three special Sticker types that change how the stickers play! (Two new types in addition to Holographic!)[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]What else has changed since the demo release? [/h2][p]Since our Next Fest demo, we’ve added quite a lot of content and new features! A huge thank you to our players for all the feedback! Besides the list of features above, here are more new additions we’ve made to the game since our demo!    [/p][list][*][p]Better crafting experience [/p][/*][*][p]Smarter opponents: we taught the children how to play the game better, so get ready for a   challenge[/p][/*][*][p]Sudden showdown: a new game mechanic to prevent card battles from dragging on for too long  [/p][/*][*][p]Achievements [/p][/*][*][p]Got rid of a lot of bugs (not the cute ones), and improved the technical side of things[/p][/*][*][p]Huge balancing improvements [/p][/*][*][p]More super cool visuals and sound effects [/p][/*][*][p]New quality of life settings [/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]How long will Early Access last?[/h2][p]We estimate that the game will be in Early Access for approximately 9 to 12 months. We have made sure to include time to add features based on our players’ suggestions. 

[/p][h2]What’s going to be added to the game during Early Access? [/h2][p]Through Early Access we will add new content and features at a steady pace. We will keep you informed on how we’re advancing with regular development updates! [/p][p]Here’s an outline of what we’ve planned to add to the game before 1.0 release. Please note that these features are not in specific order and the plans may change if needed.  [/p][list][*][p]Character customization!! [/p][/*][*][p]Challenge modes! Test out how you can fare in the game with very different demanding or maybe even silly rules [/p][/*][*][p]Expanded Collections! View to see what you’ve accomplished in the game and stare longingly at your favorite cards [/p][/*][*][p]Different difficulty settings for runs [/p][/*][*][p]Even more stickers, toys, opponents and bosses! [/p][/*][*][p]More controls for sticking stickers exactly the way you want on the cards [/p][/*][*][p]More visual customization  [/p][/*][*][p]Steam Deck support [/p][/*][*][p]Controller support [/p][/*][*][p]Accessibility settings [/p][/*][*][p]Quality of life improvements 
[/p][/*][/list][p]
[/p][h2]What’s going to happen to the demo? [/h2][p]Right now, we’re focusing on getting ready for the Early Access launch. We may disable the demo closer to Early Access launch, since the demo is a bit outdated at this point. Players trying out the demo might not get an accurate picture of what the Early Access version of the game is like, because of all the new content, features and improvements we’ve added to the game. The demo will come back as an updated version later! 

[/p][h2]Feel free to ask if you have any questions! [/h2][p]We apologize for the late announcement, and we wish we could’ve done it sooner. Every one of us here at Utu Studios is excited about what this all will mean for My Card Is Better Than Your Card! and we can’t wait for everyone to get their hands on all the new things we’ve added to the game. We’ll try our best to answer any questions you might have about the Early Access release. Thank you for reading through this![/p]

notes.title: Demo update Jun 14
notes.content:
[p]We made the following changes to the demo! All stickers should be able to be added to Collections. Please note that for a sticker to be added into your Collection, the sticker needs to be in your deck, on a card, at the run's end. Happy collecting! 🐸

[h2]Stickers[/h2]

[list]
[*] Changed Bug sticker drop chances so they can be added to Collections 
[*] Changed holo Star drop chance so it can be added to Collections
[/list]

[/p]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 9
notes.content:
We made the following changes to the demo! Thanks to everyone for playing and giving us feedback, it has helped us a ton! 🐸

[h1]General[/h1]
[list]
[*] Reward Screen now has animation that displays coins gained from Treasure tokens
[*] Starter Packs
[*] Replaced ShootingStar with Stardust in star starter pack
[/list]
[h1]Stickers[/h1]
[list]
[*] ShootingStar now gives 4 stars (up from 2)
[*] Walrus now removes 3 candy (up from 2)
[*] Sunglasses now removes 3 stars (up from 2)
[*] Increased Dragon and Crocodile holographic drop rate
[/list]
[h1]Tokens[/h1]
[list]
[*] Casette tokens now convert faster into MusicNote tokens
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Performance optimization
[*] Localization fixes
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 6
notes.content:
[p]We made the following updates to the demo. Thanks to everyone for trying it out, and giving us feedback and bug reports. If you find any issues, please let us know either here in Steam Communities section or by joining our [url="https://discord.gg/EnZhajj8D4"]Discord[/url]! 🥰 

[h1]New Features[/h1]
[list]
[*]Sticker collection view. Stickers from your deck will be added to your sticker collection after your runs!
[/list]
[h1]Opponents[/h1]
[list]
[*]The opponents will sometimes have things to say at the beginning and end of a card battle
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*]New animations between events
[*]Localization fixes
[*]Bug fixes
[*]We added more bugs (the cute ones 🪲)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update Notes Jun 2
notes.content:
Thanks to everyone for playing the demo, we made some changes based on player feedback! Let us know what you think about the changes in our [url=https://discord.gg/EnZhajj8D4]Discord[/url] or here in the community forums. 

[h1]Events[/h1]
[list]
[*] You will now get one event more each day
[/list]
[h3]Treasure Hunt[/h3]
[list]
[*] Can't give coins anymore but you earn more from card battles
[/list]
[h3]Recycling Center[/h3]
[list]
[*] You can now recycle up to 3 cards during this event
[*] You no longer get to keep the stickers from recycled cards
[/list]
[h1]Stickers[/h1]
[list]
[*] General drop rate adjustments
[/list]
[h3]Fishing Rod[/h3]
[list]
[*] Now rolls separately for each fish
[/list]
[h3]Octopus[/h3]
[list]
[*] Look 3 (down from 4) to draw 1 (down from 2)
[/list]
[h1]Starter Packs[/h1]
[list]
[*] 2 new Starter Packs
[*] Bug deck now uses the Bug Container item
[*] First new starter pack is unlocked faster than before
[/list]
[h1]Opponents[/h1]
[list]
[*] All new opponent decks
[*] Opponent decks evolve day by day
[*] The choices are more varied who to card battle
[*] They are smarter
[/list]
[h1]Misc[/h1]
[list]
[*] Bug fixes
[/list]
